acceptance_evidence: A single active-profile/connection/epoch aggregate returns current revision/storeVersion with eight distinct durable command-state counts and separate requested/confirmed effect totals.
Mixed synthetic task rows yield eight saved commands, eleven requested effects and four confirmed effects; prepared spell/Cron rows do not contribute.
Executor opt-in and configured availability remain distinct. Status reads leave task rows, executor flags and store version unchanged after existing authorization epoch establishment.
Older in-memory document state cannot replace the current joined database observation. Stale/deleted epochs reject authorization instead of returning an empty queue.
Malformed JSON, unsupported states/effects and inconsistent confirmation counts return unavailable without partial data.

Actual MCP discovery advertises an empty read-only input schema under tasks:read. Extra selectors, missing grants and cross-profile access do not expose the queue; no dispatch or upstream write occurs.
Required child T-23520ce7-554d-4848-b64b-f4be9ed39800 separates unavailable read recovery from mutation uncertainty.
limitations: Counts describe durable task receipts, not refreshed game stats or exactly-once rewards.
Normal MCP authorization epoch maintenance retains existing preparation invalidation behavior; the status function introduces no writes.
Production UI, live qualification and actual host/model interpretation remain separate.
